subject: Security discovery recap — SOC2 / pen test deliverables & SLA
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@clearvista.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: Discovery — SOC 2 / pen test / vuln SLA (next steps)

Hi Nidhi (and Samir),

Thanks again for carving out time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment: 

Key items we discussed:
- SOC 2: Redwood has an active Type II report covering our production controls; I shared the scope on the call.
- Pen test: you asked for a redacted copy of our most recent external pen test and the vulnerability handling process.
- Vendor questionnaire: you mentioned your InfoSec questionnaire and requested we start that intake.
- SLAs/cadence: we talked remediation SLAs for critical/medium findings and regular scanning cadence.

What we'll deliver / proposed timeline:
1) Redwood will provide a redacted pen test summary (redactions for customer-identifying details) + a short writeup of our vuln triage and disclosure flow — target: by EOD Thu, 2027-03-25.
2) We'll start the vendor questionnaire intake today; I attached your questionnaire (see attachment) — please flag any questions you want us to prioritize.
3) Internal scans: weekly internal vulnerability scans; external pentest cadence: annual (third-party) + targeted scans on major releases.
4) Vulnerability SLAs (proposal): critical = 30 days to remediation with 48h acknowledgement/triage; high/medium = 60 days (we can discuss tightening to 30/90 as needed for procurement).

Next actions I committed to:
- Karthik: send redacted pen test and SOC2 summary links + vuln process writeup by 2027-03-25.
- Laura (CC): confirm our scanning cadence and the standard remediation SLA language the security team publishes.
- Nidhi/Samir: confirm whether the procurement team requires a stricter medium/critical cadence and any legal redline constraints.

Attachments: ClearVista_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (as received during call)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the artifacts.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@clearvista.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@clearvista.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap: Discovery — SOC 2 / pen test / vuln SLA (next steps)

Karthik,

Thanks for the prompt recap and for taking notes — this aligns with what we discussed. A couple of follow-ups from procurement / security: 

- We need a redacted external pen test report (or a summary that includes CVE IDs and severity buckets) before legal will accept vendor terms.
- Our baseline remediation expectations: critical items fixed within 30 days; medium within 90 days. We can be flexible on non-prod timing but production issues need tighter SLAs.
- Please complete the vendor questionnaire — I attached our questionnaire copy for reference (same as we discussed).

Can you confirm whether Redwood is able to:
1) Provide a redacted pen test report (or SOC2 + pen test summary) within 3 business days?
2) Commit to 48-hour triage and acknowledgement for critical vulnerabilities?
3) Share a sample vulnerability disclosure/playbook so our security team can review?

We’re not trying to be difficult — this is procurement standard practice. If you can provide the artifacts and SLA language we’ll move forward with the mutual action plan.

Regards,
Nidhi Rao
Head of Security Operations
ClearVista Health
nidhi@clearvista.com
(212) 555-8864
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@clearvista.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Recap: Discovery — SOC 2 / pen test / vuln SLA (next steps)

FYI — forwarding Nidhi's reply. Nidhi asked for: redacted pen test (or summary with CVEs), confirmation on triage/SLA, and a vuln disclosure/playbook. Can you confirm we can meet the proposed timelines?

My suggested plan (please validate):
- Deliverables: redacted pen test summary PDF + redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf + vuln_disclosure_playbook.md.
- Timeline: ship redacted pen test + SOC2 summary by 2027-03-25 (EOD).
- SLAs: acknowledge critical within 48 hours of report; remediation target: critical within 30 days, medium within 60 days (we proposed 60 for medium to balance engineering bandwidth; procurement asked 90, so we can accept 60 or 90 — please advise).
- Scanning cadence: internal scans weekly; external vulnerability scans quarterly (automated) and annual third-party pen test (most recent: Feb 2027).

Attachments included for external send: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf (redacted summary), redwood_pen_test_redacted_march2027.pdf (redacted), vuln_disclosure_playbook.md (playbook draft).

If Laura can confirm the SLAs and approve the redacted bundle, I’ll send to Nidhi and Samir and request a follow-up remediation kickoff meeting (suggest week of 2027-03-29).

Thanks — Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Nidhi Rao <nidhi@clearvista.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Recap: Discovery — SOC 2 / pen test / vuln SLA (next steps)

Hi all — Laura from Security here. Quick confirmation and proposed wording we can put in the MSA / MAP.

1) Artifacts: we will provide a redacted external pen test summary (redwood_pen_test_redacted_march2027.pdf) and a SOC 2 Type II summary (redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf) by 2027-03-25 EOD. Redactions will remove customer IDs and IPs; CVE identifiers and severity buckets will be preserved where permissible.

2) Triage & SLA: we confirm the following commitment:
   - Acknowledgement/initial triage for critical vulnerabilities within 48 hours of receipt.
   - Remediation target: critical = 30 days; high = 45 days; medium = 60 days.
   - For exceptional/high-risk findings that affect ClearVista production, we will prioritize hotfixes and offer weekly remediation updates until resolved.

3) Scanning cadence & testing:
   - Automated internal scans: weekly.
   - External authenticated scans: quarterly.
   - Third-party pen test: annual (last completed Feb 2027).

4) Disclosure/playbook: attaching our vuln_disclosure_playbook.md (redacted) and a template Jira workflow we use to track tickets (JIRA: INF-6421). We propose to open a joint remediation Jira board if ClearVista wants shared visibility.

5) Next steps:
   - Karthik: I authorize sending the redacted artifacts to Nidhi on 2027-03-25.
   - Nidhi: after receipt, please propose a remediation kickoff time (suggest week of 2027-03-29).

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary_2026.pdf; redwood_pen_test_redacted_march2027.pdf; vuln_disclosure_playbook.md

Thanks — happy to jump on a call if teams want to walk through the playbook.

— Laura Bennett
Security Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
